body_markdown:
The current-generation[Lexus IS](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/2026-lexus-is-350-gets-new-interior-mechanical-tweaks-for-another-lap-around-the-sun/) debuted in 2014, so it’s much older than its main rivals, yet it’s sticking around for 2027. The 2027 Lexus IS inaugurates a new Special Appearance Package that includes green paint and is limited to 350 examples.


Based on the IS 350 F Sport, the Special Appearance Package features a new shade of green called Envious that was developed specifically for it. It rides on black-finished 19-inch BBS forged alloy wheels that add a touch of contrast to the exterior styling. The paint is IS-specific for now, but we wouldn’t be surprised if it’s offered on other Lexus models in the not-too-distant future.


The green and black theme continues inside with perforated NuLuxe upholstery accented with green stitching and satin chrome-finished trim. Lexus also packed a relatively long list of standard features into the Special Appearance Package, including the Handling and Technology packages, triple-beam LED headlights, a Mark Levinson sound system, and a power rear sunshade.

Lexus canned[the V-8-powered IS 500](https://www.hagerty.com/media/new-car-reviews/review-2022-lexus-is500-f-sport-performance/)[after the 2025 model year](https://www.hagerty.com/media/news/2025-lexus-is-500-ultimate-edition-specs-pictures/) , so every 2027 IS is powered by a 3.5-liter V-6 that makes 311 horsepower and 280 pound-feet of torque. The Special Appearance Package model keeps this engine. Rear-wheel drive and an eight-speed automatic transmission come standard, while all-wheel drive is optional and brings with it a six-speed automatic.


The 2027 Lexus IS Special Appearance Package will land on dealer lots later in 2026. Production is limited to 350 units for North America, though there’s no word on how many will be sent to the United States. Pricing and availability will be announced later.
